card.name: Words before antibiotic names
card.fires_on: Small linking or determiner words (and, all, other, of, a, such) and the end of an antibiotic name, in antibiotic labels. The next word is usually an antibacterial drug or class.

modes.label: Linking word between drug names
modes.description: 'and' joining two parts of a combination antibiotic such as ceftazidime and avibactam.
modes.example: c All doses of AVYCAZ are administered over 2 hours d Both ceftazidime<< and>> avibactam are hemodialyz

modes.label: Quantifier before antibacterial agents
modes.description: 'all' or 'other' just before antibacterial agents or cephalosporins.
modes.example: has been reported with use of nearly<< all>> antibacterial agents, including meropenem

modes.label: End of antibiotic name
modes.description: The last piece of an antibiotic name, before the word products.
